name: python-package
body: A Python package or module as discovered by the Python frontend: a directory containing __init__.py or __init__.pyi is a package; nested packages compose a dotted identity by walking up init-bearing ancestors; a source file with no init-bearing ancestor is a flat top-level module. The package/module is the unit of Python discovery and the parent of the files it contains — analogous to the Cargo manifest for Rust and the markdown document for Markdown. Its rendered Module FQN must be collision-free in the shared Module namespace (python-package-identity); realised by the Python frontend.
